# azurefilesacl_file_acl (Resource)

Manages Windows ACLs on an Azure Files directory or file.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `share_name` (String) Azure Files share name.
- `storage_account_resource_id` (String) ARM resource ID for the storage account. The provider derives the storage account name from this ID and, when `auth_method = "oauth"`, can fall back to ARM `listKeys` plus shared-key Azure Files calls if direct bearer-token ACL reads or writes are unauthorized.

### Optional

- `access_control_entry` (Block List) Managed access control entry. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--access_control_entry))
- `dacl_protected` (Boolean) Whether generated authoritative DACLs should be protected. Defaults to true.
- `group_sid` (String) Group SID or supported SDDL alias. Omit or set to `preserve` to preserve the existing group.
- `identity_mode` (String) Identity mode used only when a principal must be resolved through Microsoft Graph. SID-only ACLs do not require it.
- `mode` (String) ACL management mode. Supported values: `validate`, `additive`, and `authoritative`. Defaults to `additive`.
- `owner_sid` (String) Owner SID or supported SDDL alias. Omit or set to `preserve` to preserve the existing owner.
- `path` (String) Directory or file path inside the share. Defaults to `/`.
- `preserve_existing_unknown_aces` (Boolean) Whether unknown existing ACEs must be preserved. Defaults to true. Authoritative mode requires this to be explicitly false.
- `resource_type` (String) Target type. Supported values: `directory` and `file`. Defaults to `directory`.

### Read-Only

- `current_permission_key` (String) Current Azure Files permission key for the target object.
- `current_sddl_hash` (String) SHA-256 hash of the current live Azure Files SDDL.
- `generated_sddl` (String) Generated target SDDL after applying this resource's configured ACEs.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `missing_managed_aces` (List of String) Configured ACEs that are missing from the live DACL.

<a id="nestedblock--access_control_entry"></a>
### Nested Schema for `access_control_entry`

Required:

- `principal_id` (String)
- `principal_type` (String) Principal input type. Supported values: `sid`, `user`, and `group`.

Optional:

- `advanced_rights` (List of String)
- `applies_to` (String) Portal-style inheritance scope. Ignored when `flags` is set.
- `flags` (String) Raw SDDL ACE flags. Overrides `applies_to` when set.
- `rights` (String) Named rights or raw SDDL rights. Mutually exclusive with `advanced_rights`.
- `type` (String) ACE type. Supported values: `allow` and `deny`. Defaults to `allow`.
